Game Overview

Transform Car Battle is a casual game built around master the art of transformation with a futuristic vehicle, seamlessly shifting forms to outmaneuver obstacles and foes. Swipe to dodge, tap for combat mode, and switch forms to conquer gates. Hone your reflexes, unlock unique cars, and push the limits of speed and strategy.

Each session of Transform Car Battle follows a consistent rhythm. Master the art of transformation with a futuristic vehicle, seamlessly shifting forms to outmaneuver obstacles and foes.
